messages:
marta: noticing a weird reconnect storm for a tenant on canary - clients are seeing repeated reconnects during streaming.

samir: which canary? any logs/trace ids?

marta: canary id c-42, region eu-west-1. stack trace shows mid-stream 429 then client reconnects. spikes in resume_attempts metric.

leo: 429 during an ongoing SSE stream? that's odd — we usually only rate limit at request start.

marta: yep. the quota enforcer is returning 429 for chunked payloads when burst budget burns, proxy turns connection into error and client reconnects.

priya: are resume tokens being accepted after reconnects?

marta: some clients get 'resume rejected' (resume_id invalid). I think we invalidate KV cache entry on 429 path.

infra-bot: deploy 2381234600: rolled canary "quota-enforcer-v2" -> 10% in eu-west-1

samir: sounds like two problems: (1) enforcer should not invalidate resume ids on 429, (2) console/telemetry doesn't tag these spikes to a route-level dimension so canary looks noisy.

leo: +1 — we need resume_id in the quota/conn logs and add a resume_accept boolean in traces.

priya: quick mitigation: update proxy to return Retry-After header and keep session alive for short window instead of closing. clients can backoff instead of reconnect loop.

marta: code idea to parse/rewrite header at proxy:
```
if (quotaLimitReached && streamActive) {
  res.setHeader('Retry-After', Math.ceil(backoffSec));
  // preserve resume token and leave connection open with a soft-fail state
  stream.emit('soft_error', { code: 429, message: 'quota' });
}
```

samir: good. also telemetry: add tags: tenant_id, route_id, resume_id, proxy_canary=true. That will let console filter canary noise.

console-team: we can add a per-route 'streaming_resume_accept_rate' panel and an alert when resume_accept < 99.5% for 5m. Also expose a "canary-noise" toggle to exclude canary tag from top-level SLO dashboard.

leo: long-term: don't invalidate KV cache on transient quota responses; only on explicit logout/expiry.

priya: agree. PR incoming to enforcer: change transition logic and add metric counters: quota_soft_fail and quota_hard_fail.

marta: I'll patch the canary to disable sticky-region routing for this canary so those reconnections don't multiply across hosts. temporarily roll back if we see more than a 5x increase in reconnect_rate.

infra-bot: alert: reconnect-rate tenant=acme corp threshold crossed (x7) at 2381234610 :rotating_light:

samir: marking owner @priya to coordinate fix & @console-team for dashboard changes. We'll ship the proxy header patch as hotfix, then follow up with enforcer change in next deploy.

priya: I'm on it. sending PR and a short repro script to reproduce mid-stream 429.

marta: thanks. keeping this thread for postmortem notes and timeline. :thumbsup:
